preconditions: Two operating-system processes share one local SQLite file and read capacity is one
procedure_reference: Start both processes at a barrier and call acquire concurrently
expected_result: Exactly one process obtains an active lease and the other is denied or remains queued
required_evidence: Process outcomes and persisted active lease count
notes: GitHub runner test only; same host local filesystem

scenario: Preserve a live lease after coordinator object recreation
preconditions: One lease is active and coordinator object is discarded
procedure_reference: Open a new coordinator instance on the same database and validate the lease
expected_result: The persisted lease remains active until release or expiry

scenario: Keep fencing sequence monotonic across restart
preconditions: First lease is released before a new coordinator is opened
procedure_reference: Reopen coordinator and acquire a distinct request ID
expected_result: New fencing token is greater than previous token

preconditions: Acquire transaction committed and caller retries with the same request ID
procedure_reference: Replay acquire using identical owner task tenant and domain
expected_result: Original lease ID and fencing token are returned without another slot
required_evidence: Lease identity and active lease count

procedure_reference: Replay with a different task owner tenant or domain
expected_result: Idempotency conflict is returned and no new lease is created

preconditions: Coordinator commits an admission but the response is lost
procedure_reference: Reopen database and repeat acquire with the same request ID
expected_result: The original lease is returned and capacity is not double-counted
required_evidence: Unknown outcome flag request ID and lease identity
notes: Does not imply Provider was called

scenario: Prevent released or expired key reuse
preconditions: Request ID has a RELEASED or EXPIRED admission record
procedure_reference: Attempt a new acquire with the same request ID
notes: Tombstones currently have no automatic compaction

preconditions: An active lease is renewed before expiry
procedure_reference: Reopen coordinator and advance injected wall clock
expected_result: Renewed lease validates while the old lease value is rejected
required_evidence: Old and new expiry and validation results

preconditions: Database was initialized with one set of global and tenant limits
procedure_reference: Open the same file with a different policy hash

scenario: Share bounded waiters across coordinator instances
preconditions: One lease is active and another request is waiting
procedure_reference: Observe queue from a second instance then release the holder
expected_result: Waiter becomes eligible and queue row is removed after lease grant
required_evidence: Wait queue snapshots and resulting lease
notes: No durable task scheduler or multi-host queue

preconditions: Shared max_waiters is zero and one active lease occupies capacity
procedure_reference: Attempt a second request and inspect snapshot
expected_result: New request is rejected while active lease remains and rejected_queue increments by one
required_evidence: Exception type active lease count and rejected_queue counter
notes: Counter update is committed separately after admission transaction rollback
